generated_note: Hand-maintained. Nothing publishes ATP Challenger or ITF draws in a machine-readable feed; the calendar was parsed once from the 2026 ATP Challenger Tour and 2026 WTA 125 calendars and cross-checked against api.wtatennis.com for tour level.

venue_scale.note: Kalshi figures are contracts at $1 notional summed across both per-player books. Polymarket is dollar trade value on the single moneyline market. Cross-venue absolute levels are NOT comparable; rankings within a venue are.

growth_factor.note: 2025 -> current platform. The anchor is unreliable: the US Open pair gives 2.8x on raw per-match but 8.1x depth-matched, because its listing went from 170 to 532 matches. An earlier 2.1-3.4x estimate was withdrawn - it rested on a Guangzhou pair that compared the WTA 250 against the men's Challenger of the same city.

before_you_list: Confirm the listing layer can carry ATP Challenger and ITF events. Many sports integrations key off per-tour identifiers that only cover ATP and WTA main tour, and every slot-1 pick here is a Challenger.
Confirm a settlement feed exists for Challenger and ITF results. Tour-level result feeds are well covered; sub-tour is thinner and resolution risk is the main operational cost of this plan.

evidence_classes.C: 2025 only, platform 3-8x smaller - rank order more reliable than level
evidence_classes.D: Listed and dead - the strongest negative signal

confidence.measured: this event has its own settled history
confidence.range: no history for this event; range from tier and region
confidence.none: never listed anywhere - the number is a regional prior, not a measurement
